notablePrerequisites: Elemental Mastery attached to any creature you control without summoning sickness that has power one or greater.
description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to the creatures power.
The Elementals enter the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm that many times.
Resolve each Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
